[PREFERENCE] User is looking for photo editing software recommendations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended software options for photo editing based on skill levels:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Beginners:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Adobe Lightroom: User-friendly, great for organizing and editing photos, especially for batch editing. (Free trial, then $14.99/month)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Canva: Graphic design platform with photo editing features, easy to use. (Free, with optional paid features)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Google Photos: Free photo storage and editing app with basic adjustments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Intermediate Users:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Adobe Photoshop Express: Web-based version of Photoshop with advanced editing features. (Free, with optional paid features)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Skylum Luminar: Offers a wide range of tools and filters, including AI-powered editing options. (One-time purchase, $69)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Capture One: Professional-grade editor for tethered shooting and advanced RAW processing. (Free trial, then $15/month or $149/year)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Advanced Users:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Adobe Photoshop: Industry-standard software with advanced features. (Free trial, then $20.99/month)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Affinity Photo: Professional-grade editor similar to Photoshop, lower cost. (One-time purchase, $49.99)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. ON1 Photo RAW: Fast editor with advanced tools and AI-powered options. (Free trial, then $99.99/year)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing photo editing software:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Skill level  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Type of edits needed  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Budget  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - File format
